Step 4 (Outline on What A Family): Step 4 (Prepare an outline): All the parts are important and none can be left out, but it all starts with a strong foundation (p. 9).

B. Because families provide emotional support, shared responsibility, ethical values, and daily care for members while modeling cooperation, respect, and civic stewardship that strengthen the surrounding community.
C. Because family life requires one person to perform every household chore while all other members avoid communication.
D. Because communities function best when families refuse to discuss budgets, schedules, or household duties together.
choices: A. Because families exist solely to isolate members from neighborhood schools, civic groups, and extended relatives.

B. Because families provide emotional support, shared responsibility, ethical values, and daily care for members while modeling cooperation, respect, and civic stewardship that strengthen the surrounding community.
